attackers_goals: An attacker is attempting to run PowerShell without PowerShell.exe to evade detection.
description: A non-PowerShell process loaded a known PowerShell module. This image load may be an indication of PowerShell execution without directly invoking the PowerShell.exe binary.
investigative_actions: Investigate the process and command line executed and whether it's benign or normal for this host.
